ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Old Doc
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has held the physician's seat for two years now, and has set most of the bones in the colony at least once. Nobody remembers who started it, but everyone calls {PAWN_objective} Old Doc, the children included.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: Old Iron
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Two years as marshal, two years of drills in the cold before breakfast. The colony grumbles about {PAWN_nameDef}'s drills and is alive because of them, and it has started calling {PAWN_objective} Old Iron.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Unbeaten
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Three times the colony has chosen {PAWN_nameDef} to chair the council, and not once in all its elections has a vote gone against {PAWN_objective}. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} the Unbeaten, partly as a joke.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Celebrant
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: When the faith gathers the colony, for a feast, a funeral or the words at the turn of the year, it's {PAWN_nameDef} standing at the front more often than anyone. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Celebrant.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Shepherd
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has guided the colony's faith for two years: the doubts heard out at night, the quarrels about what the faith allows, the new arrivals walked through it slowly. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Shepherd.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Founder
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Ten years ago {PAWN_nameDef} stood on this ground with nothing but what {PAWN_pronoun} could carry. {PAWN_nameDef} is still here. Children who were born long after call {PAWN_objective} the Founder, and say it carefully.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: {PAWN_nameDef} founded this colony, and saw ten years of it.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Last of the First
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: Of everyone who was here on the colony's first day, only {PAWN_nameDef} is left. The others are buried, or gone down the road. People have started calling {PAWN_objective} the Last of the First, and asking {PAWN_objective} what it was like.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: With {PAWN_nameDef} goes the last of those who were here on the colony's first day. Nobody left remembers it now.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Firstborn
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} was the first child ever born in the colony, and today {PAWN_pronoun} is grown. The ones who were there that night still call {PAWN_objective} the Firstborn, and now everyone else does too.
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.deathNote: {PAWN_nameDef} was the first child ever born here.

ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.label: the Annalist
ColonyCouncil.EpithetDef.earned: {PAWN_nameDef} has written the colony's annals three years running now, in the same careful hand. The colony calls {PAWN_objective} the Annalist, and nobody else would think of taking the pen.
